instruction: I want to create a PDF from the receipt image OIP.jpg in my home folder. Please save the output as "receipt_backup.pdf" in the Documents folder.

metadata.explanation: Task converts OIP.jpg to PDF as 'receipt_backup.pdf' in Documents. Evaluator checks /home/user/Documents/receipt_backup.pdf has 1 page with image content.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: PDF file location (/home/user/Documents/receipt_backup.pdf) and content
Getter (get_vm_file) can properly extract the PDF file from VM for evaluation
Metric logic is semantically correct: checks page count (1 page for single image), file size (>10KB to ensure not empty), and verifies PDF contains images
Expected value (1 page) is semantically correct for converting a single image to PDF
Content verification (verify_content=true) ensures the PDF actually contains the converted image data, not just an empty or text-only PDF
Edge cases properly handled: missing file, None file, and empty PDF cases all return 0.0
Postconfig (2-second sleep) allows file system to sync after save operation
